claims.claim_text: The board comprises 10 members and meets four times per year as a full board.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.1 Board composition and meeting cadence
claims.support_notes: Provides governance body identification context and cadence, but does not describe responsibilities in terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related matters are integrated into board discussions; climate-related items were included on the board agenda 69.8% of the time.
claims.support_notes: Shows agenda integration/coverage but does not fully explain how and how often the board is informed about climate-related risks and opportunities (e.g., specific reporting mechanisms beyond cadence).

claims.claim_text: Board minutes record consideration of climate-related themes including transition plan review, scenario analysis, TCFD review, net zero progress, approval of carbon credits, and executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.1 Evidence of topics considered by the board
claims.support_notes: Indicates board consideration across strategy/risk/targets/remuneration topics, but does not evidence trade-offs considered, target-setting oversight details, or how performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting is provided to the board on a semi-annual basis.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.1 Reporting flow and frequency
claims.support_notes: Directly states frequency of information flow to the board (semi-annual).

claims.claim_text: Management-level responsibility for climate-related risks and opportunities is delegated to the Group Sustainability Committee.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.2 Delegated management committee
claims.support_notes: Identifies a management-level committee, but does not explain how oversight is exercised over that committee.

claims.claim_text: A dedicated ESG committee is established and meets five times per year.
claims.support_notes: Supports existence and cadence of a management forum; does not describe oversight mechanisms or integration of controls/procedures with internal functions.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks and opportunities are integrated into enterprise risk management (ERM).
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.3 Integration with enterprise risk management
claims.support_notes: States integration with ERM but lacks detail on how the governance body takes climate into account in risk management processes and related policies (and trade-offs).

claims.claim_text: A climate check is applied to major transactions.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.3 Major-transaction climate check
claims.support_notes: Addresses major-transaction consideration but does not specify board involvement, decision criteria, or trade-offs.

claims.claim_text: Board-level climate expertise is quantified at 33.5%.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.4 Board climate expertise
claims.support_notes: Provides a quantified indicator of skills/competence but does not explain the process for determining whether appropriate skills are available or will be developed.

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme is in place to support sustainability- and climate-related oversight capability.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.4 Skills development programme
claims.support_notes: States existence of development programme but does not describe how the board determines skills needs or evaluates competency gaps.

claims.claim_text: 8.7% of executive remuneration is linked to climate-related considerations.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies linkage but does not explain whether/how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies or how targets/progress are overseen.

claims.claim_text: Board minutes record executive remuneration ESG KPIs as a recurring discussion topic.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.5 Board oversight of remuneration-related ESG KPIs
claims.support_notes: Supports board oversight discussion of remuneration-related metrics, but does not provide details of the remuneration policy design or linkage to targets/progress monitoring.
